description: This file defines serialization and cloning logic for 'object' type within Orleans framework. It includes ObjectCodec for reading and writing objects, and ObjectCopier for deep copying objects.

classes.name: ObjectCodec
classes.description: Serializer for object type, handling reading, writing, and reference management.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an object value from the given reader and field.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads an object from the reader, expecting a length-prefixed wire type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes an object or specific value with optional type expectation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, utilizing the copy context.
